_doc: Ground truth for the Acme vendor quotes, read off the rendered PDFs. Money in USD. required_line_totals: goods/service lines that must be extracted. forbidden_line_totals: alternatives/optional items that must NOT be extracted as order lines. Shipping, fees and tax lines are neither required nor forbidden as order lines. commodity_group_ids: acceptable classifications (soft metric). extended (optional, added per quote as it is reviewed): department (null = must stay empty), lines (every order line with quantity and net unit price per DECISIONS D7; items only, matched by total), items_subtotal (the quote's goods subtotal, for reference), shipping / fees / tax (expected shippingAmount, feesAmount, taxAmount: the cost breakdown per D8/D9). Extended fields are scored only for quotes that have them.
